stem: Which quotation best supports the main idea of the selection?

options.label: A
options.text: The demon iPad beckoned silently from the picnic table.

options.label: B
options.text: For several years, I kept my Internet addiction under control by using inconvenient technology: a creaky laptop and a slow dial-up connection.

options.label: C
options.text: It's important not to let the convenience of the Internet get in the way of simpler beauties.

options.label: D
options.text: I love having the world's newspapers on my electronic doorstep.
